title: Critique: detecting experience a subject denies is contradictory

statements.text: If recurrent sensory activity were the basis of experience, an experimenter could detect experience in a patient who denies having it. Since experience is subjective by definition, a theory that sets aside subjective report as its measure leads to such contradictions.

sources.quote: This contradicts the notion of phenomenal experience itself, which is, by definition, a subjective, firstperson experience.
